SELECT 'APINVH' t, STAT_CD c, COUNT(*) n FROM "APINVH" GROUP BY STAT_CD UNION ALL SELECT 'GLJRNH', POST_FLG, COUNT(*) FROM "GLJRNH" GROUP BY POST_FLG UNION ALL SELECT 'GLPERD', STAT_CD, COUNT(*) FROM "GLPERD" GROUP BY STAT_CD UNION ALL SELECT 'APVEND', ACTV_FLG, COUNT(*) FROM "APVEND" GROUP BY ACTV_FLG UNION ALL SELECT 'GLCOA', ACCT_TYP || '/' || ACTV_FLG, COUNT(*) FROM "GLCOA" GROUP BY ACCT_TYP, ACTV_FLG UNION ALL SELECT 'GLJRNH_SRC', SRC_CD, COUNT(*) FROM "GLJRNH" GROUP BY SRC_CD;
